scope: Changed only the accepted-option text for all 18 cases: concise outcome decisions replace full recipe echoes, and i010 drops the unsupported access-check mechanism. Question IDs, accepted option IDs/meanings, distractors, messages, Reason, Details, prompts, and option array order are unchanged. Runtime presentation order is owned by the root fix.

items.learningObjective: Expose the committed local/external effect accurately and represent collaborator failure at its actual commit boundary.
items.decisiveFact: In A board-game campaign manager, A reward updates character points and campaign phase in one local command. If the optional audit publisher fails after that command commits, the reward remains accepted and the audit event is marked pending. What outcome should the operation expose after the collaborator fails?
items.nearestAlternative: Roll back points after the audit publisher fails, even though the reward command already committed.

v1ToV2.beforeKey: Keep the committed reward; surface the audit publication failure as pending work that can be retried without changing points again.
v1ToV2.key: Keep the reward committed; mark audit publication pending and retry without applying points again.

items.identityReason: The committed-versus-pending outcome remains the same primary decision. The key was shortened to state that outcome without restating every case fact; i010 no longer asserts an unstated access-check architecture.
sourceRefs: All commit and collaborator-failure conditions are explicit in the fictional prompt.
